html:
.shell {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  color: var(--foreground);
  background: var(--background);
}
.header {
  min-height: 64px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.brandSection {
  margin-left: 8px;
  padding-left: 16px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
}
.split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 44%) minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.story {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 64px;
  padding: 64px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.storyTitle {
  white-space: pre-line;
  max-width: 400px;
  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin: 24px 0 16px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.storyDescription {
  max-width: 360px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 24px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.storyDiagram {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 320px;
  margin-top: 64px;
}
.storyDiagram div {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.storyDiagram span {
  flex: 1;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border);
}
.storyNote {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.content {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 48px 32px;
}
.footer {
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 12px 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.footer > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
}
.authForm {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 384px;
}
.symbol {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 32px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.description {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.fields {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 24px 0 0;
  border: 0;
}
.password {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.password > input {
  padding-right: 40px;
}
.password > button {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
}
.options {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.checkLabel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.terms {
  padding-left: 36px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.terms summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.terms p {
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.fieldError {
  color: var(--destructive);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.submit {
  width: 100%;
}
.feedback {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.feedback > * {
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.hint {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.alternate {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 24px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.textLink {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  color: var(--foreground);
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.textLink:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.textLink:focus-visible,
.brand:focus-visible,
.terms summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 4px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.errorPage {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
  text-align: center;
}
.errorArt {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 0 32px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: fit-content;
}
.errorArt > span {
  font-size: 96px;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.06em;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.errorSymbol {
  position: absolute;
  left: calc(50% - 28px);
  bottom: 16px;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  background: var(--background);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.eyebrow {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.errorDescription {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 24px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}
.errorPage > .hint {
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.errorActions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.retryFeedback {
  margin-top: 24px;
  text-align: left;
}
.requestId {
  margin-top: 32px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.requestId code {
  font-size: 11px;
}
.compact .errorArt > span {
  font-size: 72px;
}
.compact .title {
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 28px;
}
.galleryMain,
.galleryContent {
  display: block;
}
.galleryContent {
  padding: 40px 32px 64px;
}
.gallery {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.galleryHeading {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.galleryTitle {
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 32px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.previewGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  align-items: start;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.preview {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--background);
}
.previewHeader {
  min-height: 48px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.previewHeader h2 {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.previewControls {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.previewBody {
  padding: 32px 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
@media (max-width: 1199px) {
  .previewGrid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .story {
    padding: 48px 32px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 959px) {
  .split {
    display: flex;
  }
  .story {
    display: none;
  }
  .header {
    padding: 16px 24px;
  }
  .brandSection {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 799px) {
  .previewGrid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .header {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .content {
    padding: 32px 16px;
  }
  .footer {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .previewBody {
    padding: 24px 16px;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .password > input {
    padding-right: 48px;
  }
}
